meta.title: Savings appear a few seconds after the stage closes, and not at all without a ranked bid

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: Savings appear a few seconds after the stage closes, and not at all without a ranked bid

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
